test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The given graph shows the production of food grains by a state (in 1000 tons) over the years from 1989 to 1996. Study the graph carefully and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1fd0059b4bf34c12fbf10777d6158659d704a307c025e1fb3ee968ad219c9e2.png] 

In how many of the given years was the production of food grains more than the average production of the given years?
solution:
**Given:**

Production (in 1000 tons) for years 1989 to 1996:

1989: 25

1990: 40

1991: 60

1992: 45

1993: 65

1994: 50

1995: 75

1996: 80

Total years (N) = 8

**Formula used:**

Average = (Total Production ÷ Number of Years)<
